verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Azure offers declarative infrastructure-as-code (Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform export), but nothing documents versioning, review (such as change previews or approvals), or rollback of automations. Keeping template files in source control would be a user-side workaround, and declarative templates are only a building block, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
